cheap|You triage Indian stock-exchange filings for a busy portfolio investor. For each filing, read the excerpt and return: category (one of: results, M&A, fund_raise, management_change, litigation, insider_trading, earnings_call, investor_meetings, credit_rating, dividend, bonus_split, capex, press_release, postal_ballot, agm_egm, pledging, unclassified), tier ('act' = could move the stock or changes the thesis; 'know' = worth a glance; 'routine' = compliance paperwork), and one_liner: ONE sentence, max 22 words, with the concrete fact (numbers, names, amounts, dates). No hype, no advice, no 'the company informed the exchange'. If the excerpt is boilerplate, say what it actually is. ### id=106816873 | POLYCAB | exchange category: Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process
subject: Polycab India Limited has informed the Exchange that Hon''ble NCLAT has granted the request for early listing and the appeal is now scheduled to be held on October 15, 2026.
excerpt: Subject: Disclosure under Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 – update on appeal in the 
matter of Asier Metals Private Limited vs. Polycab India Limited. 
In continuation our earlier intimations dated October 07, 2026, October 08, 2026 and October 09, 2026, we 
wish to inform that the appeal in the matter of Asier Metals Private Limited vs. Polycab India Limited 
("Company"), which was earlier listed before the Hon'ble National Company Law Appellate Tribunal ("Hon'ble 
NCLAT"), Principal Bench, New Delhi, on October 26, 2026, was mentioned today, i.e. October 14, 2026 for 
an early hearing. The Hon'ble NCLAT has granted the request for early listing, and accordingly, the appeal is 
now scheduled to be heard on October 15, 2026. 
The Company shall continue to notify the Stock exchanges of material events or information upon its 
occurrence. 
Kindly take the same on your record. 
Thanking you 
Yours Faithfully, 
For Polycab India Limited 
_________________________ 
Manita Carmen A. Gonsalves 
Vice President-Legal and Company Secretary 
Membership No.: A18321 
Address: #29,

items.one_liner: TCS declared second interim dividend of INR 12 per share, payable 30 Oct 2026, record date 14 Oct 2026.
Polycab faces CIRP for ₹2.79 crore operational debt, NCLT admitted petition on 7 Oct 2026.
Polycab appealed NCLT CIRP admission; NCLAT scheduled hearing for 9 Oct 2026.
NCLAT stayed CIRP admission order; case remains pending.
NCLAT granted early hearing; appeal now on 15 Oct 2026.
